name: Masamune Ren
source:
The protagonist of this work. He has a special ability to manipulate people's minds. He is cool and intelligent, but he is a bundle of dark desires.

Perhaps it is a reaction to being neglected by his mother when he was a child. He has a strong desire to bring others to their knees.

[From [url=http://www.masterup.net/hina-soft/kuro_hina/st/index.html]official site[/url]]
